failure_stage: summary serialization after checkpoint was written
measurement_defect: The first target-color rule extractor incorrectly required an Action-number condition to coexist with the target-color condition. HDS stores the target-color rule on Action6 updates with target color as its only condition, so the extractor reported zero active rules and emitted no prediction counts.
interpretation: Do not use as a valid scorecard or for adoption/rejection. The checkpoint is preserved as an incomplete diagnostic record; v2 corrected rule extraction and v3 added query caching.
